about_short_description.short_description: Tracebit provides a cloud threat detection and deception platform that employs decoy systems to attract and capture attackers.

product.name: Tracebit Platform
product.description: A cloud threat detection and deception platform that deploys canaries—realistic decoy resources, credentials, identities, and applications—to detect attacker activity with high-confidence alerts.

product.name: Tracebit Enterprise Edition
product.description: The enterprise offering of Tracebit’s canary platform, providing broad environment coverage, automated deployments, enterprise integrations, and management capabilities for production security programs.

product.name: Tracebit Community Edition
product.description: A free edition that deploys canary credentials for GitHub repositories and other limited environments, alerting users when an attacker accesses a canary.
